does: on a full moon its drowned moon rises from the pool, and its silver light heals all around
summary: A round black pool sunk in the bog, ringed by pale tusk-like spires leaning inward over a low silver orb of drowned moonlight on glowing moonmoss; at night it lights the marsh against hunters, at dawn it waters the fields, and on a full moon a moonbeam rises from it that heals every creature near, frightens off wolves and bears, greens the swamp and brings fish into the pool.
